decision_timing: The pre-execution decision and reviewed hashes were communicated before the first bounded run; this file persists that conversation decision after the run and does not invent a pre-run file timestamp.
scope: Static independent review of conditional nonrelativistic 2-to-2 number/energy/momentum/stress algebra, single internal-energy ownership and prepared new validation; not an execution PASS.
review_points: Fixed compositional total inertial mass and explicit nonrelativistic state-energy assumptions are stated; observed mass-sum roundoff residual is retained.
Number, mass, momentum, kinetic energy and raw second moments are formed from the same four event legs, then aggregated by exact species/state ID.
Axisymmetric full-CM angular moments L1=sigma0-sigma1 and N=(sigma2/3)I+(sigma0-sigma2)ee^T give the declared product momentum, energy and stress; trace(S)=2K.
Raw source centering includes +0.5*m*u^2*Gamma and its Galilean mass-source terms.
The flux is explicit; there is no automatic event rate, identical-pair factor, thermal-pool assignment or instantaneous thermalization.
Internal state energy has one population-derived witness owner and no independent duplicate internal-energy RHS.

Prepared controls use independently accumulated finite cosine/azimuth event velocities, an unchanged elastic reference at new synthetic inputs, exact hand-checkable control, threshold and closed branch, finite mass partition, rotations, product relabelling and domain/ownership rejection.
The inherited runner implementation is hash checked and directed to the new unit ROOT/OUT and fresh bounded allocation; old suites and allocations are not replayed or transferred.

condition_for_final_decision: Read actual START, FINISH and raw stdout/stderr and compare every reviewed dependency identity without rerunning science.
